name: Shoot-360 Payment Middleware API
description:
## Overview
The Shoot-360 Payment Middleware API provides a unified payment processing layer for all Point of Sale (POS) 
transactions across multiple countries (US, Thailand, Philippines, Japan). 

This middleware acts as an abstraction layer between e-commerce front-ends and third-party Payment Service Providers 
(PSPs) such as **Stripe**, **PayPal**, and **Square**.

## Key Features
- **Multi-PSP Support** — Seamlessly route transactions to configured payment providers per POS location.
- **PCI DSS Compliant** — All cardholder data is encrypted and tokenized; raw card data is never stored.
- **Multi-Currency** — Supports local currencies (USD, THB, PHP, JPY) with automatic formatting.
- **Extensible** — Easily onboard new PSPs and business capabilities (merchandise, loyalty, court rentals).

## Security & Compliance
- All API requests must use **HTTPS/TLS 1.2+**
- Card data is **tokenized** before storage; raw PAN is never persisted.
- Authentication via **Bearer JWT tokens** (OAuth 2.0) for admin endpoints.
- API keys (public/secret) are **AES-256 encrypted** at rest.
- Fully compliant with **PCI DSS v4.0** standards.

## Authentication
- **Customer-facing endpoints**: Authenticated via session tokens issued by the e-commerce platform.
- **Admin endpoints**: Authenticated via OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens with role-based access control.
